bootstrap.method: circular moving-block bootstrap, block=12 months, B=1000, percentile 95% intervals; episode metrics inside resamples inherit block-join artifacts (conservative width)

placebo.method: circular time-shift of the score path against the target (|k| >= 13 months); p = share of shifts whose metric >= observed

leadlag_hac.method: OLS of EP payroll YoY growth(t+k) on standardized indicator(t); Newey-West SE, Bartlett kernel, L=12; Bonferroni factor 13 (leads 0..12) for the family-wise column

brier_score_over_100.note: score/100 is not a probability; a negative skill score is expected and is a reason not to read the score as one

calibration.note: in-sample frequencies; Wilson intervals do not account for overlapping 6-month windows (effective n is smaller)

robustness.method: composite recomputed under alternative conventions; publication lags and targets held fixed

reading: Payroll-downturn discrimination (T2): ROC-AUC 0.825 with bootstrap 95% CI [0.634, 0.946] and placebo p = 0.0; unemployment-spike discrimination (T1): AUC 0.472, CI [0.165, 0.736], placebo p = 0.563 — indistinguishable from chance. T2 counts months already in a downturn, so it measures detection as much as warning (see the onset evaluation).
Index minus continuous Sahm statistic: ΔAUC -0.134 on T1 (CI [-0.459, 0.198]) and -0.067 on T2 (CI [-0.296, 0.146]): no evidence the index beats the simpler rule.

Episode-level rates are not estimable from 2 alert episodes: bootstrap recall interval for T2 is [0.164, 1.0]; the precision interval is degenerate because every resampled alert block sits inside a downturn.

After Newey-West correction and a Bonferroni family of 13 leads, border trade and port-of-entry crossings (El Paso + Ysleta) are coincident with El Paso payroll growth, not leading; the peso's best lead (7 months, r = 0.301) has family-wise p = 0.2713 — suggestive, not established.

The clean two-alert record (2008, 2020, nothing else) holds in 73% of the 90 alternative conventions; both historical alerts fire in 100% of them. T2 AUC stays within 0.792–0.873; T1 AUC never exceeds 0.498.
